第二十五章亡灵界的势力
现在点击已经突破五千了，虽然五千对于那些大神们不算什么，但是对于小志来说，却是一个极大的鼓励！小志会继续努力的好好写下去！在这里求点支持，推荐，收藏！都砸过来把！
陈林的这次修炼很顺利，毕竟陈林晋级最主要的灵魂条件已经达到，这次修炼只是时间长短的问题，而真正让陈林耗时间的是自己新领悟的雷罚之力。
所以陈林这次将大部分时间都用在修炼雷罚之力，不知道经过了多长时间，终于退出了修炼状态！现在陈林的实力已经达到了九阶高级，因为要完全的隔离两种能量需要大量的灵魂之力，所以陈林并没有达到预计的九阶巅峰。不过现在陈林有信心，不会败给任何九阶巅峰亡灵。
陈林在刚巩固了修为后，就开始考虑起小黑的状况“也不知道小黑现在将周围的势力收服的怎么样了，有没有什么强点的势力可以给我试试新增长的实力……”
在陈林突破的时候，小黑正在和一个很难缠的对手僵持着，对方是一个实力达到了九阶高级的巫妖，名字叫做科文！巫妖本来就是以生命力强大和魔法能力著名，这个叫科文的九阶高级巫妖更是个变异的巫妖，所以这次小黑算是遇到了对手！
小黑在这段时间的征战当中也晋级到了九阶中级，普通的九阶高级的亡灵小黑也击杀过，可是也经过十几次战斗，小黑还是没有能够将巫妖科文拿下。
最后只是不断的用手下的优势，不断的骚扰和蚕食他的势力！不过这个科文也不是省油的灯，前前后后打了好几百场，双方的势力旗鼓相当，小黑也只是以微弱的优势暂时拥有优势。
正在小黑为这个科文头疼的时候，陈林就修炼完成出关了。而且让小黑带领着队伍回来，陈林想要看看这段时间小黑的战果如何。
小黑得到消息后，马上放弃了和巫妖科文对峙，带领这手下全速赶到了陈林这里。当来到地狱犬领地后感受到陈林的实力已经是九阶高级的时候，感觉很是吃惊心想：“自己的主人这么强大，这么短的时间里就将自己给超越了。”
在小黑回来后，陈林看着小黑周围很多没见过的强大亡灵，就知道小黑这段时间肯定经历了很多。于是对小黑说道“小黑，这段时间辛苦你了，快给我说说这段时间的经历……”
原来小黑在陈林进入修炼以后，就开始不断的和周围的势力征战。在不断的征战中小黑收服了众多的势力，而且还不断的增加领地！后期小黑更是因为领地过大开始当起了指挥，指挥着好几路手下四处征战！只有在碰到对付不了的对手，小黑才会出手，现在小黑已经是整个亡灵界西南区域的风云人物~不，是风云亡灵！
听小黑形容现在陈林自己的势力，已经是亡灵界西南区域的顶尖势力了！而且在整个亡灵界也是一流势力。手下更是增添了很多高级亡灵，现在八阶的亡灵手下就有二十多个，七阶的更是达到了一千多名，现在陈林手下的总数已经拥有百余万。
“要是自己能在人类的世界拥有百万手下，那将是多么壮观的事……”陈林感慨道。
“不过主人现在，有一个比较难对付的对手……”小黑接着说道。
“哦，是什么亡灵生物，实力怎么样希望不要太弱，我正好试试身手……”陈林一听就来劲了，自己正好需要个对手，试试自己新增长的实力怎么样。
小黑接着说道“是一个九阶高级的巫妖，叫做科文！不知怎地实力很是强横，我和他对战了几十次也没能将他拿下……”
听小黑这么说，陈林很是吃惊小黑因为拥有毁灭之力，可是可以越好几级挑战的实力。但是这个对手竟然让已经九阶中级的小黑没办法，看来巫妖科文不简单！
“这样最好，正好可以放开手试试自己的实力。走！我去会会他……”陈林直接和小黑前去对付这个巫妖科文。
在一路上小黑跟陈林说了下整个地狱的势力分布，整个亡灵界分为东部、南部、西部、北部、东南、西南、西北、东北还有中部一公九个区域。在这九个区域里都有中部是整个亡灵界最大最强的区域，据说在中部区域拥有不止一个圣阶亡灵。而剩下的八个区域都有各自的势力划分。

陈林所在的区域是西南部区域，在这里有四大势力分别是九阶巅峰的骨龙捷克、九阶高级的巫妖科文、九阶高级的恶灵豪斯、九阶高级的亡灵骑士索伦！这四个势力中恶灵豪斯和亡灵骑士索伦已经被小黑征服了，而科文正是另一个势力的头领。
“这个巫妖科文相当的狡猾，在我们收服恶灵豪斯的时候，他在豪斯背后偷袭，直接被他抢去了一大半的领地和手下……”小黑补充道。
“哦，看来这个巫妖科文还真有意思，哪个骨龙捷克的势力怎么样……”陈林接着询问。
小黑回答道“骨龙捷克是西南区域实力最强大的，而且占领的西南区域近半的领地……”
一路上陈林对整个亡灵界的区域和势力有了认识，知道了圣阶才是整个亡灵界顶尖实力。而且自己现在的势力只是一个部分区域的势力，虽然已经拥有了一流的势力，但是在整个亡灵界根本不算什么。
听了小黑对整个亡灵界的介绍，陈林对自己的实力开始更渴望了“看来必须尽快达到圣阶才行，这样才能在亡灵界拥有一席之地……”
其实陈林现在的精神力已经可以探索真个西南区域，现在陈林的势力在小黑的征战下，已经能够占领了整个西南区域的五分之二，只是现在领地的大小就已经比前世的半个地球的面积要大了。陈林看着自己突然拥有的这么大的领地，就知道小黑这段时间一定忙坏了，要不是亡灵不知道疲倦，现在的小黑肯定累垮了。
陈林看到小黑在自己修炼时间的战果，很是羡慕心中想到“以后的征战就看自己的了，这样才有意思，在异界雄踞一方开疆扩域才是一个男人做的事！……”
虽然现在只是在异界的亡灵界，但是陈林知道自己早晚要去异界的人类世界，那里才是自己真正舞台！这里将是自己以后在人类异界征战的本钱和大本营，陈林要在这里建立起真正属于自己的――亡灵帝国。

Chapter 25 The forces of the undead world
Now the number of clicks has exceeded 5,000. Although 5,000 is nothing to those great masters, for Xiaozhi, it is a great encouragement! Xiaozhi will continue to work hard and write well! Ask for some support, recommendations, and favorites here! Come hit them all!
Chen Lin's training this time went very smoothly. After all, Chen Lin's most important soul condition for promotion has been met. This training is just a matter of time. What really makes Chen Lin time-consuming is his newly realized power of thunder punishment.
So Chen Lin spent most of his time cultivating the power of thunder punishment this time. After an unknown amount of time, he finally quit the cultivation state! Now Chen Lin's strength has reached the ninth level. Because it requires a lot of soul power to completely isolate the two energies, Chen Lin has not reached the expected ninth level peak. But now Chen Lin is confident that he will not lose to any ninth-level peak undead.
After Chen Lin had just consolidated his cultivation, he began to think about Xiao Hei's situation. "I don't know how well Xiao Hei has conquered the surrounding forces. Is there any stronger force that can give me a try on my new strength..."
When Chen Lin broke through, Xiao Hei was in a stalemate with a difficult opponent. The opponent was a lich with a ninth-level strength, named Kewen! Liches are originally famous for their powerful vitality and magical abilities. This ninth-level high-level lich named Kewen is even a mutated lich, so this time Xiao Hei has met his opponent!
Xiao Hei also advanced to the ninth-level intermediate level during this period of battle. He also killed the ordinary ninth-level high-level undead Xiao Hei, but after more than a dozen battles, Xiao Hei still failed to take down the lich Kewen.
In the end, he just continued to use his subordinates' advantages to harass and encroach on his power! However, this Kewen is not a fuel-efficient lamp. They have fought hundreds of games before and after. The forces of both sides are evenly matched, and Xiao Hei only has a slight advantage temporarily.
While Xiao Hei was having a headache about this topic, Chen Lin completed his training and got out of seclusion. And letting Xiao Hei lead the team back, Chen Lin wanted to see what Xiao Hei's results were during this period.
After Xiao Hei got the news, he immediately gave up the confrontation with the lich Kewen and led his men to Chen Lin at full speed. When I arrived at the Cerberus Territory and felt that Chen Lin's strength was already at the ninth level, I was very surprised and thought: "My master is so powerful and has surpassed me in such a short period of time."
After Xiao Hei came back, Chen Lin looked at the many powerful undead souls he had never seen around Xiao Hei, and knew that Xiao Hei must have experienced a lot during this period. So he said to Xiao Hei, "Xiao Hei, you have worked hard during this period. Tell me about your experience during this period..."
It turns out that Xiao Hei began to constantly fight against the surrounding forces after Chen Lin entered cultivation. In the continuous battles, Xiaohei has conquered many forces and continues to increase his territory! In the later period, Xiao Hei became a commander because his territory was too large, commanding several groups of subordinates to fight everywhere! Xiao Hei will only take action when he encounters an opponent he cannot deal with. Now Xiao Hei is already a man of the hour in the entire southwest region of the Undead World~ No, he is an undead man!
I heard Xiao Hei describe that Chen Lin's own power is now the top power in the southwest region of the Undead World! And it is also a first-rate force in the entire undead world. Many high-level undead have been added to his subordinates. Now there are more than 20 eighth-level undead, and more than 1,000 seventh-level undead. Chen Lin now has more than one million in total.
"What a spectacular thing it would be if I could have millions of subordinates in the human world..." Chen Lin said with emotion.
"But Master now has a more difficult opponent to deal with..." Xiao Hei continued.
"Oh, what kind of undead creature is it? How is its strength? I hope it's not too weak. I just want to try my skills..."Chen Lin became excited as soon as he heard this. He just needed an opponent to try his newfound strength.
Xiao Hei then said, "It's a ninth-level high-level lich called Kewen! He's somehow very powerful. I fought him dozens of times but couldn't defeat him..."
Hearing what Xiao Hei said, Chen Lin was very surprised that Xiao Hei could challenge several levels better because of his power of destruction. But this opponent actually made the ninth-level intermediate Xiao Hei helpless. It seems that Lich Kewen is not easy!
"This is the best, just so you can let go and test your own strength. Let's go! I'll go meet him..." Chen Lin and Xiao Hei went directly to deal with the lich Kewen.
Along the way, Xiao Hei told Chen Lin about the distribution of forces in the entire hell. The entire world of the undead is divided into nine regions: east, south, west, north, southeast, southwest, northwest, northeast, and central one. Among these nine areas, the central area is the largest and strongest area in the entire undead world. It is said that there is more than one holy undead in the central area. The remaining eight regions have their own divisions of power.
The area where Chen Lin is located is the southwest area, where there are four major forces: the ninth-level peak bone dragon Czech, the ninth-level advanced lich Kewen, the ninth-level advanced Evil House, and the ninth-level advanced undead knight Sauron! Among these four forces, the Evil Spirit House and the Undead Knight Sauron have been conquered by Xiao Hei, and Kewen is the leader of another force.
"This lich Kewen is quite cunning. When we conquered the evil spirit House, he sneaked up on House from behind, and he directly stole more than half of his territory and men..." Xiao Hei added.
"Oh, it seems that this Lich Kewen is really interesting. What is the influence of the Czech Bone Dragon..." Chen Lin asked next.
Xiao Hei replied, "The Bone Dragon Czech is the most powerful in the southwest region, and it occupies nearly half of the territory in the southwest region..."
Along the way, Chen Lin got to know the regions and forces of the entire undead world, and knew that the Holy Order was the top strength of the entire undead world. Moreover, his current power is only a partial regional power. Although he already has a first-class power, it is nothing in the entire world of the undead.
After listening to Xiao Hei's introduction to the entire world of the undead, Chen Lin began to be more eager for his own strength. "It seems that we must reach the holy level as soon as possible, so that we can have a place in the world of the undead..."
In fact, Chen Lin's current mental strength can already explore the entire southwest region. Now, under Xiao Hei's campaign, Chen Lin's forces have been able to occupy two-fifths of the entire southwest region, but the size of the territory now is larger than half the earth in the previous life. Chen Lin looked at the large territory he suddenly had, and knew that Xiao Hei must have been very busy during this period. If the undead didn't know how to be tired, Xiao Hei would definitely be exhausted now.
When Chen Lin saw Xiao Hei's achievements during his training, he was very envious and thought in his heart, "The future battles will be up to you. That's what makes it interesting. It's a man's job to dominate a foreign world and expand his territory!..."
Although he is only in the alien world of the dead now, Chen Lin knows that sooner or later he will have to go to the alien world of humans, where his real stage is! This will be his capital and base camp for future battles in the human world. Chen Lin will build his own empire here - the undead.
